title: Song Story Remix
shareTitle: Song Story Remix — Make Every Song Your Own
description: Choose a picture, remix a four-line song story, pick a Kawaii bandleader, rehearse it, and optionally record a private camera-and-microphone performance that stays on this device.
learningGoals: Notice how swapping one character changes a song's meaning
Follow four lyric cues in musical sequence
Build confidence through playful singing and performance
interactionModel: Pick one of three picture-led songs, swap among three story characters, choose a bandleader, rehearse against synchronized visual lyric cues, then make a stage-only show or explicitly opt into a short local camera-and-microphone recording. Save up to eight remixes in an on-device shelf and replay them with the same semantic song state.
feedbackModel: Every swap immediately rewrites the lyric card and plays a musical accent; the selected singer responds with motion; rehearsal highlights one lyric line at a time; recording uses a visible status, progress rail, and live mirror; completion adds a short Kawaii concert, teacher praise, and gentle confetti without scores or failure.

modes.title: Rainy Day
modes.skill: swap a story character and sing a four-line verse

modes.title: Space Trip
modes.skill: replace a familiar lyric subject and follow the sung story

modes.title: Jungle Walk
modes.skill: choose a lead animal and keep a steady song story

privacy.recording: optional front-camera video and microphone audio after an explicit choice; stage-only play is always equal and available
privacy.storage: IndexedDB on the current device only, capped at eight shows, with session-memory fallback

assets.runtimeNetworkScope: No runtime model, media, child-recording, transcription, or asset requests; inherited platform analytics is outside this flag.
assets.art: GPT Image 2 Kawaii production plates and contact sheets, cut with the shared asset-sheet cutter; Krea 2 hub art; Qwen Image Layered alpha separation applied to the full-resolution song cards
assets.voice: Qwen3-TTS voice-cloned teacher narration with Whisper transcript QA and device-speech fallback
assets.music: game-local Web Audio arrangements because live notes and timing are the core mechanic

credits: Original Kawaii art made with GPT Image 2 and processed with the shared QLOBE cutter; hub art made with local Krea 2; Qwen Image Layered used as a quality-gated authoring pass; narration made with the approved Qwen voice-clone reference and verified with Whisper. Child recordings never leave the device. Built with Codex for QLOBE Kids.
